# Milwaukee Bucks Fantasy Basketball Preview [26/27 NBA Season]

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-10-08, 34:42. https://youtu.be/sDzeYdUhJDI

## Summary

Josh Lloyd previews the 2026/27 Milwaukee Bucks, the team's first season without Giannis. He says it is the roster he is least sure about, with too many guards, a new coach in Taylor Jenkins, no control of their own draft pick and a likely shift toward developing young players. His projected starting five is Ryan Rollins, Tyler Herro, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kyle Kuzma and Myles Turner, with Kevin Porter Jr. as sixth man and Kel'el Ware as backup center. His best draft target is Ryan Rollins, whom ESPN undervalues. His biggest fade is Myles Turner at his current ADP, and his late swing is Kevin Porter Jr. He calls Herro reasonable around pick 60, would avoid Kuzma inside the top 200, and advises against drafting rookie Brayden Burries in standard leagues.
